name: Fair Duelist - Customizable Difficulty
summary: Customize absolute enemy health, damage, stamina costs and attack delays. Standard presets fill the controls; individual changes create Custom balance. Confirmed native difficulty changes reset matching values.
author: oOCamilleOo

file.description: Absolute percentage controls with standard difficulty presets and Custom balance. Includes the menu preset extension and preserves effective balance from older settings.

changelog: Reduce default enemy health from 90% to 75% of Fair and update the difficulty descriptions.
Add personal INI settings for enemy health, damage, stamina costs and aggression.
Choose Story, Fair, Challenging or Duelist as the starting point for numeric adjustments.
Add clear INI instructions and examples.
